# LORO

> Field sales software for South Africa — visits, route planning, pipeline, ERP integrations, and mobile app for B2B reps.

## Primary pages

- https://loro.co.za/ — Homepage
- https://loro.co.za/solutions/field-sales — Field sales software
- https://loro.co.za/solutions/visit-tracking — Visit tracking
- https://loro.co.za/solutions/route-planning — Route planning
- https://loro.co.za/solutions/pipeline — Sales pipeline
- https://loro.co.za/integrations — ERP integrations
- https://loro.co.za/pricing — Pricing
- https://loro.co.za/blog — Field sales blog
- https://loro.co.za/compare/skynamo — LORO vs Skynamo

## Product

LORO helps manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors run field sales with visit proof, maps, competitor intelligence, and optional workforce modules. Built for South African teams.
